Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Modernise UI, rewrite Signatures tab, fix capture tooling

Visual overhaul:
- Dark theme with purple accent \(#7C6FE0\) across all controls
- Custom ControlTemplates for Button, ListBox, ListBoxItem, TabControl,
  TabItem and TextBox - all rendered via WPF without focus issues
- ASCII-only strings throughout XAML/PS to avoid encoding corruption

Signatures tab - full rewrite \(3-panel layout\):
- LEFT  : signature library list \(LbSignatures\) + New/Duplicate/Rename/Delete
- CENTER: WebBrowser preview + raw HTML editor toggle \(Save / Edit HTML\)
          IE native scrollbar suppressed via overflow:hidden DOM injection
          on LoadCompleted \(HwndHost ClipToBounds workaround\)
- RIGHT : per-mailbox assignment grid \(New mail / Reply\) backed by
          Outlook registry keys; Apply to Outlook button

SignatureManager.psm1 - enterprise-grade rewrite:
- Full CRUD: New, Copy, Rename, Remove, Save HTML \(atomic\), Export/Import zip
- File-lock detection before destructive ops, structured logging
- Registry read/write for signature assignments \(global + per-account profile\)
- Backup registry key via reg export before any write

capture-window.ps1 - single-tab mode:
- New optional $Tab parameter: .\\capture-window.ps1 signatures
- Captures all tabs when omitted \(existing behaviour preserved\)

Misc:
- .gitignore added \(excludes artifacts/ screenshots\)
- build-and-run.ps1: renamed $args -> $launchArgs \(PS automatic var fix\)
- App.ps1: dot-source -> Import-Module -Force for .psm1 modules

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash("C:\\Users\\nony\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\launch_test.ps1" << 'PSEOF'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$stdoutFile = 'C:\\Users\\nony\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\app_stdout.txt'
$stderrFile  = 'C:\\Users\\nony\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\app_stderr.txt'

$proc = Start-Process powershell.exe `
    -ArgumentList '-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\\Users\\nony\\Documents\\vsco\\outlookmAnAger\\src\\App.ps1"' `
    -PassThru `
    -RedirectStandardOutput $stdoutFile `
    -RedirectStandardError  $stderrFile

Write-Host "Process started with PID: $\($proc.Id\)"

$exitedEarly = $proc.WaitForExit\(10000\)

if \($exitedEarly\) {
    Write-Host "RESULT: Process exited early \(under 10 seconds\). Exit code: $\($proc.ExitCode\)"
    Write-Host "--- STDOUT ---"
    if \(Test-Path $stdoutFile\) { Get-Content $stdoutFile }
    Write-Host "--- STDERR ---"
    if \(Test-Path $stderrFile\) { Get-Content $stderrFile }
} else {
    Write-Host "RESULT: Process still running after 10 seconds — LAUNCH SUCCESS"
    Stop-Process -Id $\($proc.Id\) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Host "Process killed cleanly."
}
PSEOF)
